note: No badge: the owners' view is of one badge, never of every award in the community.
A state that is not an AwardState: `hidden` is a holder's choice shown on each item, never an award state.
A recipient filter by DID: members are named by their community-scoped entry, never by DID.
A limit above the page ceiling of 200.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
An item without `hidden`: the owners' view always says whether the recipient hid the badge, so a hidden holder is never mistaken for one who shows it.
`nextCursor` is absent on the last page, never null.
